title: A Scorpio already knows who ate your yogurt.
old_caption:
Who ate the yogurt at work? Scorpio already knows.
But Scorpio keeps the secret and shows up with a new one. Powers used for good.

title: A Taurus at 3 AM, wide awake.
old_caption:
Lying awake over a change you didn't choose?
Taurus loses its favorite cafe and finds a new leaf on its plant. Change can be cozy too.

title: POV: a Taurus’ 14-step morning.
old_caption:
Need fourteen steps and three snoozes to start your day?
Taurus takes its time with every one. Slow mornings are self-respect.

title: Never ask a Taurus out after 8 PM.
old_caption:
Already in your robe by 8 PM when the invites roll in?
Taurus has a counteroffer: come over, I will cook. Hosting counts.

title: How a Taurus says I love you.
old_caption:
Does your partner say I love you with food instead of words?
Taurus has been cooking since three. Love, slowly and on purpose.

title: A Taurus when the plan changes.
old_caption:
Someone booked a meeting over your sacred lunch hour?
Taurus needs a minute, adapts slowly, and still eats the sandwich. Steady pays.

title: tiny typo in the deck, fixed it.
old_caption:
Replaying one sentence you sent hours ago?
Virgo checks the chat and it was fine, kind even. You're allowed to be unfinished.

title: POV: a Virgo's to-do list has a to-do list.
old_caption:
Does your to-do list have its own to-do list?
Virgo labels everything, then labels itself DONE. Done is enough.

title: A Virgo planned the group trip to the minute.
old_caption:
Is there a friend in your group who plans trips down to the minute?
Virgo adds one row for whatever comes up. Leave room for fun.

title: 6:32 PM — date night, organised.
old_caption:
Is your love language quietly fixing their whole calendar?
Let them clear an evening for you too. Care goes both ways.
